subject: Re: Pilot credits / pricing follow-up & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits / pricing follow-up & burn-rate check-in

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same notes and next steps: 

- Current pilot scope: endpoint for clinical note summarization + in-app assistant for triage.
- Current integration status: ingestion pipeline connected; UI calls stubbed, not fully in prod.
- Pilot objectives: evaluate latency under realistic load, quality of summaries, and unit economics for projected volume.

A few items I need to confirm to size pricing and credits:
1) Estimated steady-state token volume (generation + context) — what do you expect per request and overall weekly/monthly?
2) Budget range for the pilot / expected $/1M tokens target — are you evaluating for a $/1M target (ballpark) or a fixed monthly budget?
3) Any other decision criteria (SLA, dedicated capacity) we should flag now.

Related to credits — you mentioned needing extra runway while you finish the UI integration. If you can share current burn-rate (we usually look at tokens/week) I can propose a credits-extension number and run it by our finance owner.

Attachments: I pulled the small pilot_usage_export.csv from the seed tests you shared this morning and the pilot_kpis.xlsx you sent to Priya.

Proposed next steps:
- You send estimated token volumes + preferred budget band (reply to this thread)
- I return a quick price sketch (target $/1M tokens) and a credits-extension recommendation within 24 hours
- Assuming we agree, I’ll request approval from finance and confirm credits and expiry date

If easier, we can do a 15-min sync — I have availability Wed/Thu afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

--
Attachments (referenced): pilot_usage_export.csv, pilot_kpis.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits / pricing follow-up & burn-rate check-in

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — confirm on our side:

- Estimated request profile: ~1.2k requests/day for the assistant (avg ~1,800 tokens/request incl. context) and ~300 summarization requests/day (avg 2,500 tokens).
- Est. tokens: ~ (1,200 * 1,800 * 30) + (300 * 2,500 * 30) ≈ 64M tokens/month (peak). Our initial conservative planning target is 20–30M tokens/month while we ramp.
- Budget: initial pilot budget is narrow — we’re aiming for <$10k/month for hosted inference during pilot. Ultimately target economics are ~$150 / 1M tokens or better to be a viable production option for the team.

Current pilot burn-rate: from your seed tests we’re seeing ~400k tokens/week (mainly internal QA + spike testing). We need another 2–3 weeks of runway to finish the UI integration before we drive production-like traffic.

Credits request: would appreciate 2 weeks extension on the trial credits (roughly additional 1M tokens of usable credit) — that should let us finish the UI work and run a short ramp test.

Let me know if you need any more detail and if that budget target is in line with Redwood’s public pricing for comparable models.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Product Manager, Acme Health
alex@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credit extension for Acme Health (DEAL-2027-ACME-42) — 1M tokens / 2 weeks

Vivek / Michael —

Quick ask: Acme Health (Alex + Priya) are requesting a short extension to the trial credits to finish UI integration and run a 2-week ramp. Their current burn-rate is ~400k tokens/week and they’ve asked for ~1M extra tokens (usable credit) to cover the ramp and QA.

Context: they expect to ramp to ~20–30M tokens/month if the pilot goes well, and their budget target is <$10k/mo with a target cost of ~$150 / 1M tokens. We typically approve small pilot credits to remove integration friction and avoid losing momentum.

Proposed credit extension: 1,000,000 tokens usable credit, expires 2027-07-06 (2-week extension). I’ve attached the pilot_usage_export.csv and a short note for finance.

If approved, I’ll confirm back to Alex and set a mid-pilot check (2 weeks after extension start) to review burn and discuss committed pricing.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credit extension for Acme Health (DEAL-2027-ACME-42) — 1M tokens / 2 weeks

Marissa —

Approved. Please proceed with the following:
- Grant 1,000,000 token credit to Acme Health, expiring 2027-07-06.
- Note in the deal record (HubSpot): credit_amount=1M_tokens; credit_expiry=2027-07-06; reason=integration runway.
- Schedule a mid-pilot check on 2027-06-30 to review actual burn and conversion indicators (latency, error-rate, sample-quality).

Also flag to finance for bookkeeping — I’ll include the credit in the monthly pilot credits memo.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Alex / Priya —

Good news — we’ve approved a 1,000,000 token credit extension for Acme Health, expiring 2027-07-06. You should see the credit applied to the pilot account within the hour.

What I’ll do next:
- Add credit details to the HubSpot deal record and attach the pilot_usage_export.csv (for our tracking)
- Schedule a 25-min check on 2027-06-30 to review burn-rate, latency, and early quality signals. Please confirm if 10:00-10:30 PT works for you both.

On pricing: based on the volumes you shared, I’ll send a target pricing sketch in the follow-up (ballpark $/1M tokens at $120- $180 depending on model family and batching/quantization). That will give you a baseline against your $150 target.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
